column4: A big heavy armoured knight stands still, feet planted wide, breathing slowly and shifting his weight, calm and watchful.
A slender woman is hit on the left shoulder, flinches and twists back a step, then recovers her balance.
A heavy armoured knight with a shield raised on his left arm makes one short, compact forward jab with a club in his right hand, then returns to a guarded stance.
